01
Service 01
Engineering &
Design Services

Every Jayveecons project begins with engineering. Before a single piece of steel is cut, our team works through your process requirements, site conditions, and operational parameters to produce a design that is optimised for your specific application — not adapted from a generic template. We produce full fabrication drawings, material specifications, drive calculations, and civil foundation loads. Our designs are built to last: equipment that is over-engineered rarely, but never under-engineered.

Process engineering: capacity calculations, material flow analysis, equipment sizing for your bulk density, particle size, and throughput
Mechanical design: shaft, bearing, and structural calculations; drive selection and power sizing; conveyor and elevator geometry
Fabrication drawings: full GA drawings, detail drawings, weld maps, and BOM for workshop fabrication and client approval
Civil input: foundation load data, anchor bolt patterns, and equipment layout drawings for your civil contractor
Material specifications: grade selection for abrasion, corrosion, temperature, and food-grade compliance requirements
Reverse engineering: existing equipment documented and redesigned for improved performance or material substitution
Discuss your engineering requirements
02
Service 02
In-House
Fabrication

Jayveecons fabricates everything we design. Our 90,000 sq.ft facility in Bengaluru houses a fully equipped machining and fabrication shop — plate rolling, structural fabrication, CNC machining, precision turning, welding, and surface treatment all under one roof. Building in-house means we control quality at every stage, maintain dimensional accuracy to our own drawings, and avoid the communication gaps that come with subcontracting critical components to third parties.

Plate rolling & forming: conveyor troughs, kiln shells, silo and tank bodies to large diameters
Structural fabrication: conveyor support structures, platforms, and galleries in MS, galvanised, or painted finish
Precision machining: shafts, pulleys, idler spindles, flanges, and bearing housings on CNC lathes and mills
Welding: certified welders in MIG, TIG, and arc processes; stainless, carbon steel, and alloy materials
Materials: mild steel, abrasion-resistant (AR) steels, stainless 304/316, food-grade specifications
Quality inspection: dimensional inspection, weld inspection, pressure testing, and pre-dispatch trial assembly where required
Discuss fabrication requirements
03
Service 03
Erection &
Commissioning

Equipment that leaves our workshop performing to specification must arrive at your site performing to specification. Jayveecons' erection and commissioning teams carry the same engineering knowledge as our design team — because they are the same team. On-site, we handle mechanical assembly, shaft alignment, drive installation, electrical interlocking coordination, no-load trials, and process load commissioning, ensuring every system reaches its rated performance before we hand over.

Civil coordination: survey, setting-out, and anchor bolt checking before equipment arrival
Mechanical assembly: full equipment erection, shaft alignment, bearing setting, belt tensioning, and coupling installation
Drive installation: gearbox mounting, V-belt or coupling alignment, VFD integration, and motor rotation checks
No-load trials: full-speed mechanical trial before material introduction; vibration, noise, and temperature checks
Commissioning: material introduction, throughput ramp-up, performance measurement, and parameter optimisation
Operator training: on-site training for your plant operators on start-up, shutdown, and routine maintenance procedures
Discuss your installation project
04
Service 04
Parts, Spares &
Ongoing Support

Because we manufactured your equipment, we already have the drawings, the material specifications, and the manufacturing knowledge to produce exact replacement parts — without the reverse-engineering delay that comes with ordering from a firm that didn't build it. Jayveecons maintains a spares programme for all VECTOMEC™ equipment we supply, and can manufacture replacement components for third-party equipment where our capability matches the requirement.

OEM replacement parts: exact replacements for all Jayveecons-supplied equipment, manufactured to original drawings
Wear parts: conveyor belts, elevator buckets, screw flights, idler rollers, liner plates — high-turnover items stocked or fast-fabricated
Third-party equipment: reverse-engineered spares for equipment from other manufacturers where we can match the specification
Emergency supply: expedited fabrication for breakdowns affecting production — we understand the cost of downtime
Spares register: we help clients establish and maintain a critical spares holding programme for planned shutdowns
Upgrade components: improved-specification replacements that address known wear patterns or operational issues in the original design
Order parts or discuss spares strategy
05
Service 05
Repairs &
Refurbishment

Not every problem requires new equipment. Jayveecons provides repair and refurbishment services for existing material handling and processing equipment — both our own and third-party — extending service life, restoring performance, and in many cases upgrading the original specification. Our workshop repair capacity handles everything from shaft reconditioning and pulley re-lagging to complete conveyor and elevator refurbishment. Where on-site repair is required, our field teams can attend at your plant.

Condition assessment: site visit and inspection report with repair vs replace recommendation and cost comparison
Workshop repairs: shaft reconditioning, bearing housing repair, pulley re-lagging, belt vulcanising, structural weld repair
On-site repairs: field welding, emergency fixes, and planned shutdown maintenance for equipment that cannot be moved
Refurbishment: complete strip-down, inspection, component replacement, and reassembly to like-new standard
Performance upgrades: capacity increases, wear-resistance improvements, and automation additions during refurbishment
VSK refurbishment: specialist rebuilds of Vertical Shaft Kiln systems — refractory relining, grate replacement, shell repair
Request a repair or refurbishment assessment
Our Service Promise

Why Single-Source
Matters

In industrial equipment, the weakest link is almost always the handoff. When a design firm passes a drawing to a fabricator, and the fabricator passes equipment to an installation contractor, and the contractor hands over to a maintenance team — critical knowledge is lost at every transfer. Nobody owns the outcome.

Jayveecons is built to eliminate that problem. The engineer who designed your conveyor is available to answer your installation team's questions. The fabricator who built your kiln can diagnose why a component has worn faster than expected. The commissioning engineer can write the maintenance procedure because they ran the machine.

"Customer satisfaction comes in providing cost-effective and superior products and services coupled with technological innovation."

That philosophy was written into our founding mission in 1987. Every service we offer exists to deliver on it.
